'''Dogweed''' is a tea with a taste that is considered extremely unpleasant. It is often used as a punishment to encourage the patient to end his or her moping behavoir. [[Rand al'Thor]] once reminded [[Egwene al'Vere]] that [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] dosed her with dogweed tea.{{ref/book|4|7}}
